corrections.reason: The second ሥ in ወየኃሥሡከ has the 2nd-order (ካዕብ) vowel mark on the right leg, matching the plural Ge'ez verb form ('they seek you') parallel to ይቀውሙ.
The canonical Ge'ez verb for 'went out' in Mark 4:3 is ወፍረ (with 6th-order ፍ), which is clearly visible in the print.
Both visual inspection (no top left hook on ነ) and Classical Ge'ez construct state grammar confirm ዕዝነ ሰሚዓ ('an ear of hearing').
